title: The Importance of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
summary: Discover how 2FA adds an extra layer of security beyond just your password.
content: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is a security process where a user provides two different authentication factors to verify themselves. This typically involves something you know (like a password) and something you have (like a code sent to your phone or generated by an authenticator app). Even if cybercriminals steal your password, they cannot access your account without the second factor.
